item.title: CVE-2026-128118: SvelteKit: Build-time server-only module import guard could fail, resulting in server secrets being statically replaced in client bundle
item.description: Severity: high. Under certain circumstances, server-only imports, which typically cannot be included in the client bundle, could make their way into it, potentially exposing secrets. This could only occur when those server-only imports were made through `src/params.js`.

item.title: CVE-2026-128120: SvelteKit: DoS while parsing form data from a remote functions `form`
item.description: Severity: high. This only affects applications using the experimental remote functions flag and utilizing the `form`, `query`, or `command` remote functions. A specially-crafted request could block the event loop for extended periods of time during parsing.

item.description:

item.title: Six Unpatched Danfoss Refrigeration Controller Flaws Could Allow Remote Takeover Without Login
item.description: Six flaws in Danfoss AK-SM800A refrigeration controllers could let a remote attacker take over a controller without logging in, Dutch security consultancy Midnight Blue said earlier this week. No patch is available, and the researchers say the newest firmware, version 5.4.0, does not fix the flaws.
